test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pointing to a photograph of a boy, Madhvi said, “His father is my sister's husband's daughter's maternal grandfather's son”. How is the boy related to Madhvi's father?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24da8914664d10453c9d9ab26b8ab431f913e3fc49dcd23b79b6043ac90be683.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d06f732efe9cc2965af3e62994d1c78232de77b782406dc0afaeedb7fb09bea.png] 

Clearly, the boy is Paternal grandson of Madhvi's father.

Hence, '**Paternal grandson**' is the correct answer.
